title: Head of Project Management
description:
**Job Specification: Head of Project Management**

Location: On-site Monday to Friday. B-708, Mondeal Heights, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 

Salary: Up to ₹30,00,000 per annum (depending on experience and skills) 

Working Pattern: 5 days per week, Monday through Friday. 8.5hr work day with 1 hour break. 

**About Us**

Established in 2014, Data Kraken is a dynamic analytical consultancy firm based in Oxford, United Kingdom. We provide expert advice and solutions to businesses and organisations by leveraging data analysis, AI, and cloud technologies. 

We have now expanded our global footprint by creating a new branch in India! As an early hire at our new office in Ahmedabad, you will experience the exciting growth of a fresh local team backed by the stability, resources, and 12-year history of our established UK parent company. 

Location & Working Pattern

This is a full-time role based at Mondeal Heights, Ahmedabad. While the position is predominantly on-site (Monday to Friday), we offer flexible afternoon WFH options for the right candidate.

Mondeal Heights is conveniently located on the SG Highway with easy access to public transport and parking. 

**Our Tech Stack**

We primarily do our work in the cloud, using AWS and GCP. We typically receive large volumes of data from our clients, which we process into a suitable format for further analysis. While some client data remains in client-hosted environments, most projects are executed within our cloud setups.

Across the business, we also use Google Workspace for our day-to-day work, alongside Atlassian tools like Jira and Confluence.

**About the Role**

Job Title: Head Of Project Management

We are seeking an experienced Head Of Project Management to lead a small team of Project Managers, lead on end-to-end technical project delivery, streamline process workflows, and manage client relationships. In this role, you will operate with high autonomy.

You will own technical project roadmaps, mitigate risks and act as a primary liaison between clients and the technical engineering teams. 

You will bring strong technical acumen to understand data engineering and software delivery nuances, paired with deep expertise in modern project management frameworks and toolsets. 

Key Responsibilities:

* End-to-end Project Delivery: Take full ownership of complex, multi-stream data and software projects simultaneously. Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and ensure timely delivery within scope and budget.
* Process & Jira Optimisation: Serve as the internal authority on project workflows. Set up, configure, and maintain advanced Jira project spaces, dashboards, and Confluence documentation to track delivery velocity and provide clear stakeholder reporting.
* Working Across Teams: Drive collaboration between data analysts, engineers, and executive stakeholders. Ensure team alignment with project goals and remove delivery blockers swiftly.
* Quality & Risk Control: Establish frameworks for project quality assurance, risk mitigation, and clear scope definition (including drafting detailed Project Charters and SOWs).

**About You**

*Required Experience & Skills:*

* 5+ years of proven project management experience within a technical, software development, or data consultancy environment.
* Deep expertise in Jira & Confluence: Advanced mastery of Atlassian tools, including board setup, workflow configuration, metric reporting, and process automation.
* Technical Background: Hands-on background or strong working familiarity with roles across software/data delivery (e.g., prior experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Scrum Master).
* Communication & Documentation: Exceptional written and spoken English. Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear deliverables for clients and write robust project documentation (Project Charters, SOWs, status reports).
* Agile & Delivery Mastery: Proven success designing, implementing, and refining end-to-end delivery processes across the full project lifecycle.
* Cross-timezone flexibility and planning: Willingness to adjust hours occasionally to collaborate with UK-based teams
* Team leadership experience.
* Formally recognised credentials (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, CSM, or PSM).
* Experience working within the Telecommunications (Telco) industry.
* Familiarity with Google Workspace tools.

**Company Benefits**

* 22 Days Annual Leave (This combines 15 Earned + 7 Casual), 7 Days Paid Sick Leave, 8 Public Holidays
* Enhanced leave: 10 Days Paid Paternity Leave, Paid Bereavement Leave and More
* Clear opportunities for career growth and technical development with a generous L&D Stipend, English lessons could be offered to the right candidates
* Group Medical Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover.
* Tea & coffee and occasional snacks provided at the office
* Team lunches, and social events

**Our Culture**

We are a social, close-knit team that genuinely enjoys spending time together.

We are bringing the same friendly, collaborative vibe from our Oxford office straight to Ahmedabad.

We don’t just work in the same building, we have lunch together as a team, celebrate our wins, and host social events and team outings. If you are looking for a solo, isolated desk job, this isn't it.

We value great communication, a friendly attitude, and someone who wants to be an active part of our growing work family.

At Data Kraken, we believe in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

We want all candidates to shine in this process – please let us know if there’s anything we can do to make sure the application and assessment process works for you.

title: Project Lead
description:
**Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QAQC) Manager - Civil Works**
**JLL Project and Development Services**
**Position Overview**
The QAQC Manager for Civil Works ensures all civil construction activities within JLL's Project and Development Services portfolio meet specified quality standards, regulatory requirements, and client expectations through systematic inspection, testing, and documentation processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Management & Compliance**
Develop and implement comprehensive quality assurance and quality control plans for civil works projects including site development, earthworks, utilities, paving, drainage, and related infrastructure. Ensure all construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, building codes, and regulatory requirements. Conduct regular site inspections and audits to verify conformance with quality standards and identify non-conformities requiring corrective action.
  
  
**Inspection & Testing Coordination**
Oversee field inspection activities for concrete works, soil compaction, underground utilities, asphalt paving, and other civil elements. Coordinate with third-party testing laboratories for materials testing including soil density tests, concrete cylinder breaks, aggregate gradation, and asphalt quality verification. Review and approve test results, ensuring they meet project specifications before authorizing work progression.
  
  
**Documentation & Reporting**
Maintain comprehensive QAQC documentation including inspection reports, test results, material certifications, non-conformance reports, and corrective action records. Prepare regular quality reports for project managers, clients, and stakeholders summarizing inspection activities, test results, and quality metrics. Ensure all quality records are properly filed and readily accessible for audits and project closeout.
  
  
**Contractor Management**
Review contractor submittals for materials, equipment, and construction methodologies to verify compliance with specifications. Conduct pre-construction meetings with contractors and subcontractors to communicate quality expectations and inspection requirements. Monitor contractor quality control activities and verify their internal QC processes are effective.
  
  
**Standards & Procedures Development**
Develop and maintain QAQC procedures, checklists, and standards specific to civil works within JLL's Project and Development Services. Implement industry best practices and lessons learned from previous projects to continuously improve quality management processes. Train project teams on QAQC procedures and quality documentation requirements.
  
  
**Non-Conformance Management**
Identify deficiencies and non-conforming work through systematic inspections and testing programs. Issue non-conformance reports and work with contractors to develop acceptable corrective action plans. Verify implementation of corrective actions and document resolution of quality issues.
  
  
**Stakeholder Communication**
Serve as the primary point of contact for quality-related matters with clients, contractors, consultants, and regulatory authorities. Participate in project meetings to provide quality status updates and address quality concerns. Coordinate with design teams to resolve constructability issues or specification clarifications affecting quality.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field required. Minimum 8-10 years of experience in quality assurance/quality control for civil construction projects. Prior experience with project and development services or construction management firms preferred.
  
  
**Technical Knowledge**
Thorough understanding of civil construction methods, materials, and specifications for earthworks, concrete, asphalt, utilities, and site development. Knowledge of relevant building codes, standards (ACI, ASTM, AASHTO), and regulatory requirements. Familiarity with construction testing procedures and acceptance criteria for civil works materials.
  
  
**Professional Certifications**
Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent professional certification preferred. QAQC-related certifications (CQM, CQA, or similar) highly desirable. Current knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems beneficial.
  
  
**Skills & Competencies**
Strong analytical skills with attention to detail for reviewing technical documents and identifying quality issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills for preparing reports and interfacing with diverse stakeholders. Proficiency in quality management software, inspection tools, and Microsoft Office suite. Ability to read and interpret civil engineering drawings and specifications.
  
  
**Working Conditions**
Position requires regular site visits to active construction sites with exposure to outdoor weather conditions and construction hazards. Must be able to walk construction sites, climb ladders, and access all areas requiring inspection. Some travel between multiple project sites may be required depending on portfolio assignments.
  
  
*This position supports JLL's commitment to delivering exceptional project outcomes through rigorous quality management and continuous improvement in civil works construction.*

He has a board meeting on Friday. He thinks of three companies that could help him fix it.
  
  
Today, isaga is not one of those three. This job exists to change that.
  
  
**Why this job exists**
isaga helps companies spend less on AWS. Have you heard of listed company - Mamaearth. Yes, we work with them.
  
  
This year we lost deals we should have won. Our offer was not the problem. The buyer had simply never heard of us.
  
  
A good product nobody remembers loses to an average one everybody knows. That is a marketing problem. We want you to solve it.
  
  
**What We Think Marketing Is**
Most buyers are not buying today. In B2B, only about 5 in 100 are in the market at any time. The other 95 will buy later, and when they do, they choose from names already in their head.
  
  
So marketing has two jobs. Make the brand easy to think of when the need shows up. Make it easy to find and buy from at that moment.
  
  
Logos, posts, websites and events are all tools for these two jobs. Attention is the scarcest thing in marketing, and in hiring too. So here is a small task: prepare one slide, with three bullet points, on why we should hire you. Our first conversation will start there. We have put this task here, in the middle of a paragraph, only to see who reads carefully and who has attention to details. A brand people recognise in one second beats a clever campaign people forget. It only works if you keep at it.
  
  
**What You Will Build**
Every task below does one of the two jobs above.
  
  

* Brand assets people recognise. Colours, shapes, a story, a way of writing. The test: would someone know a post is ours with the logo hidden?
* Content on our own channels. The isaga LinkedIn page, the website, blogs and podcasts. Visual content first.
* Content on other people's channels. Communities, newsletters, other people's podcasts, the AWS Marketplace. Go where our buyers already spend time.
* Events. We believe offline is the future of B2B marketing: small rooms where our buyers meet each other and meet us. You will help us test this.

**Your first 6 months**
Content comes first, so you will spend most of your time on 1 and 2.
  
  

* Month 1: Learn how we sell. Sit in on customer calls. Make the isaga LinkedIn page something people notice, and post every week.
* Month 2: Rebuild the website around one clear story. We know what we want. You execute it, then make it better.
* Month 3-6: A content engine that runs without reminders. You work with outside agencies, for example on AI search. You plan our first event.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* 1 to 2 years of marketing experience.
* You are the first hire. So you will end up doing a lot of things. You will set up the base for the future of marketing at isaga.
* You are curious and diligent. We mean it.

+ Diligent: It's not easy being diligent. You deliver on what is agreed. If you are falling behind, you tell us before we ask. This looks very simple, but not easy. This is how high performers work.
+ Curious: You ask how we can do a better job, and how we can create distinctive brand assets.

* You are ready to operate on the ground. Start with the isaga LinkedIn page: make it distinctive and keep posting interesting content. Then help us build a website with a real story. We know what we want. You execute, refine and improve. You will also work with outside agencies, for example on AI search.
* You use AI, but you think. You will not blindly copy-paste content from AI.
* You bring new ideas. Marketing is about building distinctive assets, so you should be able to come up with new ideas. We will make you think.
* You are passionate about building a great brand.

**Who Should Not Apply**

* You want to run ads and report clicks. That is not this job, at least not yet.
* You want a team and a big budget on day one.
* You need detailed instructions for every task.
* You think a JD with a story in it is a bit much.

**You think this is risky?**
Being the first marketer at a small company.
  
  
Here is what is riskier: three years at a big company where nobody can point to one thing you built. At isaga, everything you make will carry your name, the good and the bad.
  
  
**December 2027**
A founder in Bengaluru asks a friend, "Who should I call about our AWS bill?" The friend says, "Talk to isaga."
  
  
Nobody paid for that sentence. You built it, one post, one page and one event at a time.
  
  
**Want to get our attention?**
We get a lot of applications, so don’t make yours just another CV in the pile.
  
  
**Here Are a Few Things You Can Do**

* Find the email ID of Aditya Kshirsagar and send your CV directly.
* Look at our website. Pick one thing that looks like every other AWS partner. Tell us how you would make it ours, in one page or a 3-minute video.

*This JD is version 1. If you join, your first task is version 2.*

The Senior Manager – Global Supply Chain & Depot Operations owns the operational performance, standards, capacity and controllable costs of AVASO's global depot network. The role ensures reliable warehouse execution, inventory integrity, secure asset handling, logistics coordination and customer-specific operational SLA compliance across owned and third-party locations.

The role leads distributed teams, manages operational budgets within delegated authority, develops network capacity and drives quality, WMS governance and continuous improvement. It works within AVASO's end-to-end service delivery framework: SCM is accountable for depot execution and readiness; the Global Services Organisation (GSO) retains accountability for applicable client service commitments and technical solution design. Strategic procurement and commercial pricing are outside this role's primary scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Global Depot & Warehouse Operations**

* Own daily depot performance, site readiness, staffing coverage, physical controls, storage effectiveness and safe working practices across the global network.
* Govern receipt, inspection, put-away, storage, picking, staging, packing, dispatch, returns and backlog, ensuring timely and accurate fulfilment.
* Apply consistent operating standards across owned and partner sites while meeting approved client-specific work instructions and service levels.

**B. Inventory Governance, Asset Custody & Loss Prevention**

* Ensure inventory accuracy, serial-level movement traceability and documented custody of customer assets through receipt, storage, transfer and disposition.
* Enforce cycle counts, reconciliations and controlled WMS stock adjustments; investigate variances, loss, damage and unauthorized movement.
* Own depot incident reporting and corrective action; coordinate evidence, claims, insurance support and recoveries with authorized functions.

**C. IT Asset Lifecycle, Security & ITAD**

* Govern staging, imaging, configuration, kitting, repair coordination, testing, refresh, return, grading, refurbishment and ITAD execution within approved scopes.
* Enforce controlled data erasure, verification evidence, certificates, disposal approvals, chain-of-custody records and compliant vendor handovers.
* Ensure customer and information-security requirements are documented and exceptions are escalated promptly.

**D. Logistics & Cross-Border Movements**

* Oversee shipment planning, domestic and international movements, courier collection, tracking, proof of delivery and shipment-exception recovery.
* Coordinate IOR/EOR, customs and shipping documentation with trade specialists and approved partners; control avoidable freight and expedite costs.

**E. Global Team Leadership & Resource Management**

* Lead regional depot personnel and central operations teams; set priorities, coach managers and enforce performance ownership and training compliance.
* Manage schedules, deployment of approved resources, productivity and contingencies; propose structural headcount changes through the approval process.

**F. GSO Interface, Depot SLAs & Customer Escalations**

* Remain accountable for depot operational SLAs and corrective actions; alert GSO/Service Delivery early when depot failures threaten end-to-end commitments.
* Lead depot investigations, recovery execution and root-cause actions; coordinate customer-facing commitments and communications through the authorized service owners.
* Provide operational feasibility, dependencies and delivery evidence for GSO-led solutions, transitions and service reviews.

**G. Service Catalogue & Operational Standards**

* Align every depot service to approved AVASO Service Catalogue items, scope, SOPs, standard processing times, quality acceptance criteria and completion evidence.
* Control deviations from standard workflows and partner with GSO on feasibility and readiness for new or modified depot service capabilities.

**H. Financial Performance & Cost-to-Serve**

* Manage controllable depot operating expenditure within approved budgets; review variances, unit costs and productivity with Finance and SCM leadership.
* Monitor cost per device, repair, shipment and storage unit, plus overtime, rework, freight premiums, losses and obsolete-stock exposure.

title: Senior Analyst - Credit Analysis
description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Value Proposition**
At First Citizens India, you’ll have the opportunity to be more than just an analyst, you’ll be a trusted partner in safeguarding the Bank’s credit portfolio.
  
  

* Global Exposure: Collaborate directly with Senior Credit and Risk professionals in the U.S., gaining insights into global credit practices.
* Impactful Work: Play a critical role in monitoring a multi-billion-dollar credit portfolio, helping the Bank stay resilient and client-centric.
* Career Growth: Build your expertise in Credit analysis while having access to structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to move into leadership roles.
* Innovation at Scale: Be part of a team driving process improvement and technology adoption in Credit monitoring.
* Culture of Stability & Growth: Join a Bank that has thrived for over 125 years, balancing stability with continuous growth and innovation.

**Job Details**

* Position Title: Senior Analyst, Credit Analysis
* Career Level: P2
* Job Category: Senior Associate
* Role Type: Hybrid
* Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

**About the Team: Credit Analysis**
We are a diverse and highly skilled team of Credit professionals, experienced in Origination, Underwriting, and end-to-end Portfolio Monitoring.
  
  
Our team specializes in Technology & Healthcare Accelerator & Growth, Corporate Banking, Sponsor Finance, Fund Banking, Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Healthcare – Medical Office Building (MOB), Wine, Community Assistance Banking (CAB), and Community Development Finance (CDF) loans monitoring across Innovation Banking, Fund Banking, Commercial Finance and General Bank. Additionally, the team supports the Centralized Cash Management Team (CCMT). Team works closely with US-based Credit Solutions team, Credit Officers, and Portfolio Managers to perform monthly, quarterly & annual monitoring of the loans.
  
  
**Impact**
As a Senior Analyst in the Credit Analysis team at First Citizens India, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the Bank’s credit quality and supporting informed lending decisions. This role is critical to enabling the Bank to make confident lending decisions, manage risks effectively, and maintain trusted relationships with clients. In this role, you will Leverage tools such as Moody’s Credit Lens, and other commercial lending platforms to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights.
  
  
You’ll Partner with Global Credit teams to ensure Risk management and strengthen Portfolio performance.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**
As a Senior Analyst – Credit Analysis, you will play a critical role in supporting the ongoing management of Bank’s Credit portfolio. You will work closely with U.S. based Credit Officers, Portfolio Managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality analysis and monitoring insights that help safeguard the Bank’s Credit exposure while ensuring client success.
  
  
**General Functions May Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Credit Portfolio Monitoring: Support ongoing monitoring of assigned credit portfolio to identify potential risks and ensure compliance with Loan agreement and risk policies.
* Reporting Tasks Monitoring: Monitor and track monthly/quarterly reporting packages (arriving from US counterparts) to check for completeness of client information on the portal.
* New Client Addition and Modification: Set up/upload new client information in the portal in tune with Loan Security Agreement; monitor and update the modifications in the portal in accordance with Loan Modification Agreements.
* Financial Spreading & Analysis: Spread and analyze financial statements of borrowers in Moody’s CreditLens, identifying key trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Covenant Monitoring: Track borrower compliance with financial and non-financial covenants, raising early alerts on potential breaches.
* Borrowing Base Calculations: Perform accurate and timely borrowing base calculations, ensuring alignment with loan documentation and lending practices.
* Reporting & MI: Prepare recurring and ad-hoc reports to provide insights into portfolio performance, sectoral trends, and emerging risks.
* Risk Alerts & Escalations: Support early identification of problem credits through financial deterioration, covenant breaches, or industry headwinds.
* Collaboration: Partner with U.S. stakeholders across Credit, and Operations to ensure consistent standards, accuracy, and timeliness in deliverables.
* Process Improvement: Contribute ideas to enhance automation, standardization, and efficiency in portfolio monitoring processes.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure high level of accuracy in performance of all tasks. Adhere to reporting, financial spreading and covenant calculation KPIs/metrics, completing work within agreed to turnaround times. Report incidents of non-compliance items (e.g., differences in financial statements provided by client) to lead analyst/manager on a timely basis.
* Mentoring juniors: Monitor tasks to be completed by other team members and support the manager in mentoring and training of new hire analysts.

**Skills And Qualification**
**Functional Skills:**

* Hands-on experience in spreading, covenant monitoring, and credit reporting.
* Strong knowledge of corporate lending products, credit documentation, and financial statement analysis.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while being an active team contributor.
* Efficient and well organized, able to work under tight deadlines
* Outstanding attention to detail, accuracy, and ability to multitask
* Ability to be flexible with shift timings (2 pm – 11 pm)

**Technical Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce / MBA(Finance).
* Chartered Accountant / CFA / equivalent qualifications will be an added advantage.
* Experience: 3–5 years of experience in credit analysis, portfolio monitoring in a bank, NBFC, or financial services firm.
* Exposure to US accounting, GAAP, and IFRS
* Proficiency in MS Excel and financial analysis tools; familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau is an advantage.

**Leadership Qualities**

* This is an individual contributor role; however, the role may require adhoc workflow management/ supporting team leaders/managers as warranted.
* High level of ownership and self-drive towards proactive portfolio risk management
* High on Self-management and situational leadership

**Relationships & Collaboration**
This role involves working with the Credit Analysis team, reporting to the Credit Analysis Manager. This role will have comprehensive training across credit analysis processes, owning and managing an independent portfolio and collaboration with the lending team and other stakeholders. This role also requires strong communication, and teamwork skills are essential.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodation at any stage (e.g. application, interviews, onboarding) please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.

title: Senior Trust & Assurance Program Manager - Confluent
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
The Office of the CISO (OCISO) is part of Confluent’s Trust and Security organization. Its mission is to turn trust into growth by shortening sales cycles and enabling consumption, and to scale regulatory assurance by anticipating industry and customer requirements before they become blockers. The OCISO Enablement Lead will oversee and execute global trust enablement programs and capabilities to support global and regional teams in driving security and compliance assurance. This includes developing scalable processes for customer due diligence, contractual compliance, customer audits, and trust-focused external communications, incl. customer executive engagement programs. The role demands operational independence, with the ability to deliver initiatives at scale while seeking leadership direction when necessary. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential to manage processes effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization. This is a remote-based position.
  
  
Primary Responsibilities:
  
  

* Collaborate with GTM teams to implement and scale global and regional Field and Customer enablement programs
* Act as a subject matter expert on customer security assurance and regulatory requirements, providing actionable guidance on emerging regulations affecting cloud adoption, including privacy, data residency, digital sovereignty, and AI
* Execute the product trust and compliance roadmap in coordination with Product, Engineering, and Legal Teams.
* Build and continuously improve a Trust as a Service model that moves routine customer assurance to self-service and automation with relevant success criteria and metrics.
* Apply AI and automation to scale trust programs with human review, and translate AI governance expectations into customer-facing trust content
* Analyze feedback and metrics from Field and Customer processes to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement in OCISO operations
* Foster strong cross-functional relationships with Enterprise CISO and Compliance, Sales, CSG, Product, Engineering, Legal, and GRC teams to support trust-building initiatives and ensure alignment

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
Required Skills and Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree with 8+ years of experience in Information Security and Compliance.
* Expertise in cloud/SaaS environments with complex security and compliance requirements, either as a provider or customer.
* Proven experience managing cross-functional security and compliance programs.
* Knowledge of key regulations and frameworks, including GDPR, DORA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, CSA, NIST, and other regional/industry standards.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
Additional highly desirable experience:
  
  

* Current Security CISSP, CISA, CISM, CIPP, or equivalent certification completed or currently in progress
* Excellent verbal and written communication, organizational, and planning skills
* Knowledge of regulatory standards relevant to EMEA & APAC and regulated industries (e.g., APRA, MAS, HKMA, IRAP, OSPAR, DORA)
* Understanding of digital sovereignty and data residency requirements relevant to cloud adoption
* Familiarity with AI/ML security and governance considerations, including evolving regulatory expectations for AI in cloud environments
* Prior experience reviewing and negotiating security clauses within customer contracts a plus
* Able to independently lead and manage internal process and operational improvement programs
* Self-starter who builds and iterates on new service models and moves quickly with limited supervision
* Interpersonal skills to work as a team member and as a liaison

title: Sr. Software License Program Manager
description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
OpenText Compliance Organization conducts periodical audits on our customers, analyzes the data collected and presents the results in front of the customers. We have a global team with unique roles and responsibilities. Our Asset Amendments team is responsible for analyzing the data provided for a software license transfer, coordinating with other stakeholders in our team and providing ample support to the field including Compliance Managers, Sales and Maintenance reps.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**
The Asset Amendments Analyst will be primarily responsible for the following roles/tasks:
  
  

* Analyzing Software License Transfer (SLT) request
* Preparing a preliminary analysis of the request and sharing it with Compliance Managers for their inputs
* Extracting the contracts and entitlements for both transferor and transferee
* Preparing the software license agreement along with the fees
* Creating a quote with the software license fee accurately
* Validating the signed software license agreement and performing the actual transfer of assets
* Drafting and sharing the completion letters with stakeholders
* Advising/consulting accountable stakeholders in OpenText, as needed
* Coordinating with compliance managers and/or sales reps and/or maintenance reps as needed independently to ensure the SLT process is completed in the required timeframe.
* Escalating issues arising during the process promptly and following up on the resolution
* Being able to handle end to end SLT process independently
* Being a subject matter expert on the process
* Understand, suggest and implement process improvements
* Identifying areas of automations
* Proactively understand, suggest and implement process improvements including identifying areas of automation
* Guided by company policies, defined objectives and professional standards, independently leads projects and processes
* Will be focused on individual deliverables which may involve coordinating and guiding the work of others
* Will be accountable for end-to-end processes, smaller scale projects, and deliverables
* Adapts to ambiguity in some situations recommending courses of appropriate action
* Needs to enhance relationships and networks with senior internal/external partners who are not familiar with the subject matter

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Must have SAM/Software License Auditing or Software License Transfer experience of at least 5 years
* Strong data analytical skills supported by fact-based decision making
* Proficient knowledge of Excel is a must
* Proficient reporting skills desired
* Ability to critically analyze and use fact-based decision making
* Flexibility to work in global shifts if needed
